name: Bug-B-Gone
description: A concentrated cleaner formulated to quickly loosen and dissolve insect and hard-to-remove residue from exterior vehicles surfaces. Designed not to streak painted or metal surfaces.
application: DIRECTIONS: SURFACE SHOULD BE COOL AND OUT OF DIRECT SUNLIGHT. TEST PRODUCT ON AN INCONSPICUOUS AREA FOR COMPATIBILITY BEFORE USING IT ON THE ENTIRE SURFACE. Dilution: Always dilute with at least 2 parts water to 1 part product. 1) Spray or wipe on affected area and allow product to remain on surface for 1-2 minutes. 2) Wipe off bug splatter with a clean towel. For stubborn residue, scrub area with a bug sponge or soft brush. 3) Rinse area thoroughly with water.
